/-- Closed primitive-conductor reduction for a certified nonprincipal Dirichlet character.

The record packages the algebraic part of reduction to a primitive character: the conductor is
positive and divides the original modulus, its primitive character is nonprincipal, and changing
level back to the original modulus recovers the input character exactly.  This makes no analytic
claim about the relation between the associated Dirichlet `L`-functions or their zeros. -/
structure CGLPrimitiveCharacterReduction
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) where
  conductor : ℕ
  conductor_pos : 0 < conductor
  conductor_dvd_modulus : conductor ∣ n + 1
  primitiveCharacter : DirichletCharacter ℂ conductor
  primitive : DirichletCharacter.IsPrimitive primitiveCharacter
  nonprincipal : primitiveCharacter ≠ 1
  induced_eq : DirichletCharacter.changeLevel conductor_dvd_modulus primitiveCharacter = χ.1

/-- Every certified nonprincipal character is induced from its nonprincipal primitive character
at its conductor. -/
noncomputable def cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :
    CGLPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ where
  conductor := χ.1.conductor
  conductor_pos := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (DirichletCharacter.conductor_ne_zero χ.1)
  conductor_dvd_modulus := χ.1.conductor_dvd_level
  primitiveCharacter := χ.1.primitiveCharacter
  primitive := χ.1.primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive
  nonprincipal := by
    intro h
    have hind := χ.1.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter
    rw [h, DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_one] at hind
    exact χ.2 hind.symm
  induced_eq := χ.1.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter

/-- The conductor in the closed primitive reduction is the standard conductor of the input. -/
theorem cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction_conductor_eq
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :
    (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).conductor = χ.1.conductor :=
  rfl

/-- The character packaged by the closed reduction is primitive. -/
theorem cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction_primitive
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :
    DirichletCharacter.IsPrimitive (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).primitiveCharacter :=
  (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).primitive

/-- The primitive character packaged by the closed reduction is nonprincipal. -/
theorem cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction_nonprincipal
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :
    (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).primitiveCharacter ≠ 1 :=
  (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).nonprincipal

/-- Changing level from the conductor in the closed reduction recovers the input character. -/
theorem cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction_induced_eq
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel
      (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).conductor_dvd_modulus
      (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).primitiveCharacter = χ.1 :=
  (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).induced_eq

end RHTower

# Chen--Gupta--Li Lemma 6.2: closed primitive functional-equation bridge

Lemma 6.2 reflects the Mellin integral for a character-Poisson transform
through the functional equation of the primitive inducing character.  This
module records that exact algebraic-analytic bridge with all character
conditions carried by a certified packet.  It deliberately does not claim the
lemma's contour shift, truncation, or error estimate; those are separate proof
obligations.
-/

open Complex
open scoped LSeries.notation

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower

/-- A literal positive-modulus primitive nonprincipal character suitable for
the reflection step in CGL Lemma 6.2.  Primitivity and nonprincipality are
certified data; exported theorems expose no raw mathematical premise. -/
structure CGLLemma62PrimitiveCharacter where
  modulus : CGLPositiveModulus
  character : DirichletCharacter ℂ modulus.value
  nonprincipal : character ≠ 1
  primitive : DirichletCharacter.IsPrimitive character

/-- The primitive completed Dirichlet `L` functional equation in the exact
form consumed after the source contour is shifted to the left. -/
theorem cglLemma62_primitiveCompletedL_one_sub
    (P : CGLLemma62PrimitiveCharacter) (s : ℂ) :
    DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction P.character (1 - s) =
      (P.modulus.value : ℂ) ^ (s - 1 / 2) * P.character.rootNumber *
        DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction P.character⁻¹ s := by
  exact P.primitive.completedLFunction_one_sub s

/-- Complex conjugation changes a primitive source character into its inverse
character, exactly as required by the reflected CGL Dirichlet polynomial. -/
theorem cglLemma62_primitiveCompletedL_conj
    (P : CGLLemma62PrimitiveCharacter) (s : ℂ) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction P.character s) =
      DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction P.character⁻¹ ((starRingEnd ℂ) s) := by
  exact conj_completedLFunction P.nonprincipal s

/-- Closed completed-`L` reflection in conjugate form.  This combines the
functional equation and the character conjugation identity without adding a
hypothesis on the contour point. -/
theorem cglLemma62_primitiveCompletedL_reflection_conj
    (P : CGLLemma62PrimitiveCharacter) (s : ℂ) :
    DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction P.character (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) s) =
      (P.modulus.value : ℂ) ^ ((starRingEnd ℂ) s - 1 / 2) * P.character.rootNumber *
        (starRingEnd ℂ) (DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction P.character s) := by
  rw [cglLemma62_primitiveCompletedL_one_sub, cglLemma62_primitiveCompletedL_conj]

/-- The left vertical line used in the first CGL contour shift never meets the
exceptional origin, so its uncompleted `L`-function is exactly the completed
function divided by its Gamma factor. -/
theorem cglLemma62_primitiveLFunction_leftLine_eq_completed_div_gamma
    (P : CGLLemma62PrimitiveCharacter) (v : ℝ) :
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction P.character ((-1 : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * I) =
      DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction P.character ((-1 : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * I) /
        P.character.gammaFactor ((-1 : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * I) := by
  apply DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_completed_div_gammaFactor
  left
  intro h
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
  simp at hre

/-- The reflected right vertical line has real part two, hence the continued
Dirichlet `L`-function is its absolutely convergent `LSeries`. -/
theorem cglLemma62_inverseLFunction_rightLine_eq_lseries
    (P : CGLLemma62PrimitiveCharacter) (v : ℝ) :
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction P.character⁻¹ ((2 : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * I) =
      L ↗P.character⁻¹ ((2 : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * I) := by
  apply DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_LSeries
  norm_num

end RHTower

/-- The source's primitive inducing character is primitive at its actual conductor. -/
theorem bondarenkoHeapPrimitiveInducer_isPrimitive
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :
    DirichletCharacter.IsPrimitive (bondarenkoHeapPrimitiveInducer n χ) := by
  exact χ.1.primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive

/-- A nonprincipal character cannot acquire the principal character as its primitive inducer. -/

    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :
    bondarenkoHeapPrimitiveInducer n χ ≠ 1 := by
  intro h
  have h' : χ.1.primitiveCharacter = 1 := by
    simpa only [bondarenkoHeapPrimitiveInducer] using h
  apply χ.2
  rw [← χ.1.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter, h']
  simp

    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :

exactly. This is the finite algebraic support reduction behind Lemma 10's prime-power error. -/

    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n)
    (a : BondarenkoHeapSourceUnitInteger (n + 1)) :
    bondarenkoHeapPrimitiveInducer n χ a.1 = χ.1 a.1 := by

/-- Analytic multiplicity of an actual primitive Dirichlet `L`-zero. -/
def primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity
    {n : ℕ} {chi : PrimitiveNonprincipalDirichletCharacter n}
    (rho : PrimitiveDirichletLZero n chi) : ℕ :=
  (analyticOrderAt (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1) rho.point).toNat

theorem analyticOrderAt_LFunction_ne_top_at_primitiveDirichletLZero
    {n : ℕ} {chi : PrimitiveNonprincipalDirichletCharacter n}
    (rho : PrimitiveDirichletLZero n chi) :
    analyticOrderAt (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1) rho.point ≠ ⊤ := by
  apply analyticOrderAt_ne_top_of_entire_exists_ne_zero
  · intro z hz
    exact (DirichletCharacter.differentiable_LFunction chi.1.2).analyticAt z
  · refine ⟨(2 : ℂ), ?_⟩
    exact DirichletCharacter.LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re chi.1.1
      (Or.inl chi.1.2) (by norm_num)

/-- All lower jets vanish and the jet at the exact analytic multiplicity is nonzero. -/
theorem primitiveDirichletLZero_exactJets
    {n : ℕ} {chi : PrimitiveNonprincipalDirichletCharacter n}
    (rho : PrimitiveDirichletLZero n chi) :
    (∀ j < primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity rho,
      iteratedDeriv j (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1) rho.point = 0) ∧
    iteratedDeriv (primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity rho)
      (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1) rho.point ≠ 0 := by
  have hana : AnalyticAt ℂ (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1) rho.point :=
    (DirichletCharacter.differentiable_LFunction chi.1.2).analyticAt rho.point
  have hm :
      ((primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity rho : ℕ) : ℕ∞) =
        analyticOrderAt (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1) rho.point :=
    ENat.coe_toNat
      (analyticOrderAt_LFunction_ne_top_at_primitiveDirichletLZero rho)
  have hjets :=
    GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.GelfondSchneiderProof.analyticOrderAt_eq_nat_imp_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero
      hana (primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity rho) hm.symm
  simpa only [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate] using hjets

/-- Every Dirichlet `L`-jet is transported to the inverse character by
Schwarz reflection. -/
theorem iteratedDeriv_LFunction_inv_conj
    {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (chi : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    (hchi : chi ≠ 1) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    iteratedDeriv m (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi⁻¹)
        ((starRingEnd ℂ) z) =
      (starRingEnd ℂ)
        (iteratedDeriv m (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi) z) := by
  have hfun :
      (starRingEnd ℂ) ∘ DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi ∘
          (starRingEnd ℂ) =
        DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi⁻¹ := by
    funext w
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      (LFunction_inv_conj chi hchi ((starRingEnd ℂ) w)).symm
  have h := congrFun
    (iteratedDeriv_conj_conj (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi) m)
      ((starRingEnd ℂ) z)
  rw [hfun] at h
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using h

/-- Holomorphic continuation of the primitive-character visible-coprime symbol. -/
def visibleCoprimeDirichletKernel
    (n : ℕ) (chi : PrimitiveNonprincipalDirichletCharacter n)
    (s t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1 s *
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1⁻¹ t *
      principalDirichletInv (n + 1) (s + t)

/-- Hermitian mixed jet at an actual primitive Dirichlet `L`-zero. -/
def visibleCoprimeDirichletMixedJet
    {n : ℕ} {chi : PrimitiveNonprincipalDirichletCharacter n}
    (rho : PrimitiveDirichletLZero n chi) : ℂ :=
  let m := primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity rho
  iteratedDeriv m
    (fun s => iteratedDeriv m
      (fun t => visibleCoprimeDirichletKernel n chi s t)
        ((starRingEnd ℂ) rho.point)) rho.point

/-- The two Leibniz expansions leave only the leading conjugate pair of
Dirichlet `L`-jets. -/
theorem visibleCoprimeDirichletMixedJet_eq_raw
    {n : ℕ} {chi : PrimitiveNonprincipalDirichletCharacter n}
    (rho : PrimitiveDirichletLZero n chi) :
    visibleCoprimeDirichletMixedJet rho =
      iteratedDeriv (primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity rho)
          (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1) rho.point *
        iteratedDeriv (primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity rho)
          (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1⁻¹)
            ((starRingEnd ℂ) rho.point) *
        principalDirichletInv (n + 1)
          (rho.point + (starRingEnd ℂ) rho.point) := by
  have hinv : chi.1.1⁻¹ ≠ 1 := inv_ne_one.mpr chi.1.2
  have hsum :
      rho.point + (starRingEnd ℂ) rho.point =
        ((2 * rho.point.re : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    add_conj_eq_ofReal_two_re rho.point
  have hpos : 0 < 2 * rho.point.re := by linarith [rho.re_pos]
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℂ (primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity rho)
      (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1) rho.point :=
    ((DirichletCharacter.differentiable_LFunction chi.1.2).analyticAt
      rho.point).contDiffAt
  have hg : ContDiffAt ℂ (primitiveDirichletLZeroMultiplicity rho)
      (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi.1.1⁻¹)
        ((starRingEnd ℂ) rho.point) :=
    ((DirichletCharacter.differentiable_LFunction hinv).analyticAt
      ((starRingEnd ℂ) rho.point)).contDiffAt

/-!
# P3 for actual self-dual primitive Dirichlet L-functions

Every nontrivial primitive self-dual Dirichlet character gives an actual completed automorphic
GL(1) L-function.  Its completed divisor satisfies the universal complete-strip reflection law:
the zero set is infinite, all zeros lie in the open critical strip, closed-disc zero packets are
finite, and self-duality turns the functional equation into `rho ↦ 1-rho` invariance.

Therefore none of these automorphic completions has a smooth Real-corona idempotent in the natural
dense endpoint-entire reflection crossed product.
-/

noncomputable section

open Complex Set

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N]

/-- Actual completed GL(1) automorphic divisor as an instance of the universal compactification
law. -/
def selfDualPrimitiveDirichletCompleteStripDivisor
    (chi : SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum N) : CompleteStripReflectionDivisor where
  completed := DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction chi.character
  zeroSetInfinite := _root_.RHTower.completedLFunction_zeroSet_infinite chi.nontrivial
  zero_mem_openUnitStrip := fun hz =>
    _root_.RHTower.completedLFunction_zero_mem_openUnitStrip
      chi.nontrivial chi.primitive hz
  zero_reflect := by
    intro z hz
    have hFE := chi.primitive.completedLFunction_one_sub z
    rw [chi.selfDual, hz, mul_zero] at hFE
    exact hFE
  zeros_closedBall_finite :=
    _root_.RHTower.completedLFunction_zeros_closedBall_finite chi.nontrivial

/-- Exact smoothness classification for each actual self-dual primitive Dirichlet completion. -/
theorem selfDualPrimitiveDirichlet_corona_crossedProduct_iff_finite
    (chi : SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum N) :
    let D := selfDualPrimitiveDirichletCompleteStripDivisor chi
    let R := D.holomorphicReflection
    letI := R.functionAction
    letI : SMulCommClass ReflectionParity ℂ
        (((D.upperSector ∪ D.lowerSector : Set ℂ) → ℂ)) := R.functionSmulCommClass
    SkewMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ReflectionParity)
        (endpointRealCoronaIdempotent D.upperSector D.lowerSector) ∈
      Set.range (InvariantSubalgebra.crossedProductInclusion
        (endpointHolomorphicInvariantSubalgebra R.endpointInvariant)) ↔
      D.upperSector.Finite ∧ D.lowerSector.Finite := by
  exact (selfDualPrimitiveDirichletCompleteStripDivisor chi).corona_crossedProduct_iff_finite

/-- **P3 for the full actual self-dual primitive Dirichlet family:** smoothness never occurs. -/
theorem selfDualPrimitiveDirichlet_corona_not_mem_smoothCrossedProductRange
    (chi : SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum N) :
    let D := selfDualPrimitiveDirichletCompleteStripDivisor chi
    let R := D.holomorphicReflection
    letI := R.functionAction
    letI : SMulCommClass ReflectionParity ℂ
        (((D.upperSector ∪ D.lowerSector : Set ℂ) → ℂ)) := R.functionSmulCommClass
    SkewMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ReflectionParity)
        (endpointRealCoronaIdempotent D.upperSector D.lowerSector) ∉
      Set.range (InvariantSubalgebra.crossedProductInclusion
        (endpointHolomorphicInvariantSubalgebra R.endpointInvariant)) := by
  exact (selfDualPrimitiveDirichletCompleteStripDivisor chi).corona_not_mem_smoothCrossedProductRange

/-- Functional-equation reflection acts on the actual automorphic corona by complement. -/
theorem selfDualPrimitiveDirichlet_odd_smul_corona_eq_complement
    (chi : SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum N) :
    let D := selfDualPrimitiveDirichletCompleteStripDivisor chi
    let R := D.holomorphicReflection
    letI := R.functionAction
    ReflectionParity.odd • endpointRealCoronaIdempotent D.upperSector D.lowerSector =
      1 - endpointRealCoronaIdempotent D.upperSector D.lowerSector := by
  exact (selfDualPrimitiveDirichletCompleteStripDivisor chi).odd_smul_corona_eq_complement

end GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

/-!
# Finite primitive-conductor family transport for positive zero-density windows

For a fixed ambient modulus `n + 1`, every nonprincipal character has a
canonical primitive nonprincipal source at a literal divisor conductor.  This
file builds that finite divisor-indexed target family, proves the source map
injective using its closed change-level left inverse, and transports the
positive-window zero count into the family sum.

The resulting inequality is the finite all-characters-to-primitive-divisors
accounting step in Chen--Gupta--Li Section 12.  It deliberately stops before
the subsequent source analytic zero-density estimate.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower

/-- A primitive nonprincipal Dirichlet character at a literal divisor of the
ambient modulus `n + 1`. -/
structure CGLPrimitiveNonprincipalCharacterAtDivisor
    {n : ℕ} (d : (n + 1).divisors) where
  character : DirichletCharacter ℂ d.1
  nonprincipal : character ≠ 1
  primitive : DirichletCharacter.IsPrimitive character

noncomputable instance cglPrimitiveNonprincipalCharacterAtDivisor_fintype
    {n : ℕ} (d : (n + 1).divisors) :
    Fintype (CGLPrimitiveNonprincipalCharacterAtDivisor d) :=
  Fintype.ofInjective CGLPrimitiveNonprincipalCharacterAtDivisor.character (by
    intro x y hxy
    cases x
    cases y
    cases hxy
    rfl)

/-- The divisor carrier itself proves its value nonzero, so completed
Dirichlet `L`-functions at literal divisor conductors need no caller premise. -/
instance cglNeZero_divisor
    (n : ℕ) (d : (n + 1).divisors) : NeZero d.1 :=
  ⟨by
    intro hdzero
    rcases (Nat.mem_divisors.mp d.2).1 with ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hqzero : n + 1 = 0 := by
      calc
        n + 1 = d.1 * k := hk
        _ = 0 := by rw [hdzero, zero_mul]
    exact (Nat.mem_divisors.mp d.2).2 hqzero⟩

/-- Map an ambient nonprincipal character to its canonical primitive
nonprincipal character at the literal conductor divisor. -/
noncomputable def cglPrimitiveConductorDivisorFamilyIndex
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :
    Sigma (CGLPrimitiveNonprincipalCharacterAtDivisor (n := n)) :=
  ⟨cglPrimitiveConductorDivisor n χ,
    ⟨cglPrimitiveCharacterAtConductorDivisor n χ,
      cglPrimitiveCharacterAtConductorDivisor_nonprincipal n χ,
      cglPrimitiveCharacterAtConductorDivisor_primitive n χ⟩⟩

/-- Recover an ambient nonprincipal character by changing level from a
primitive divisor-family member. -/
noncomputable def cglInducedNonprincipalCharacterOfDivisorFamilyIndex
    (n : ℕ)
    (x : Sigma (CGLPrimitiveNonprincipalCharacterAtDivisor (n := n))) :
    NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n := by
  refine ⟨DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (Nat.mem_divisors.mp x.1.2).1 x.2.character, ?_⟩
  intro hprincipal
  have hsource : x.2.character = 1 :=
    (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_eq_one_iff (χ := x.2.character)
      (Nat.mem_divisors.mp x.1.2).1).mp hprincipal
  exact x.2.nonprincipal hsource

/-- Inducing the canonical primitive divisor-family image recovers the
original ambient character exactly. -/
theorem cglInducedNonprincipalCharacterOfDivisorFamilyIndex_apply
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) :
    cglInducedNonprincipalCharacterOfDivisorFamilyIndex n
      (cglPrimitiveConductorDivisorFamilyIndex n χ) = χ := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [cglInducedNonprincipalCharacterOfDivisorFamilyIndex,
    cglPrimitiveConductorDivisorFamilyIndex,
    cglPrimitiveCharacterAtConductorDivisor]
  exact (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).induced_eq

/-- The canonical map from ambient nonprincipal characters to primitive
divisor-family members is injective. -/
theorem cglPrimitiveConductorDivisorFamilyIndex_injective
    (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (cglPrimitiveConductorDivisorFamilyIndex n) := by
  intro χ₁ χ₂ h
  calc
    χ₁ = cglInducedNonprincipalCharacterOfDivisorFamilyIndex n
        (cglPrimitiveConductorDivisorFamilyIndex n χ₁) :=
      (cglInducedNonprincipalCharacterOfDivisorFamilyIndex_apply n χ₁).symm
    _ = cglInducedNonprincipalCharacterOfDivisorFamilyIndex n
        (cglPrimitiveConductorDivisorFamilyIndex n χ₂) := congrArg _ h
    _ = χ₂ := cglInducedNonprincipalCharacterOfDivisorFamilyIndex_apply n χ₂

/-- The completed-`L` zero count in a certified positive window for one
primitive character at one literal divisor conductor. -/
def cglPrimitiveDivisorCompletedWindowCount
    {n : ℕ} (d : (n + 1).divisors)
    (ψ : CGLPrimitiveNonprincipalCharacterAtDivisor d)
    (W : CGLPositiveZeroDensityVerticalWindow) : ℝ :=
  (↑(∑ᶠ z, MeromorphicOn.divisor (DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction ψ.character)
    W.carrier z) : ℝ)

reduction has exactly the divisor-family count of its mapped image. -/

GL(1) L-functions, not abstract analytic carriers. -/
structure SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] where
  character : DirichletCharacter ℂ N
  nontrivial : character ≠ 1
  primitive : character.IsPrimitive
  selfDual : character⁻¹ = character

theorem SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum.dirichletXi_differentiable
    (χ : SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum N) :
    Differentiable ℂ (_root_.RHTower.dirichletXi χ.character) := by
  change Differentiable ℂ (fun s : ℂ =>
    (N : ℂ) ^ (s / 2) * DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction χ.character s)
  apply Differentiable.mul
  · apply Differentiable.const_cpow
      (differentiable_id.div_const (2 : ℂ))
    exact Or.inl (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne N))
  · exact DirichletCharacter.differentiable_completedLFunction χ.nontrivial

theorem SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum.exists_dirichletXi_ne_zero
    (χ : SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum N) :
    ∃ z, _root_.RHTower.dirichletXi χ.character z ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨σ, _, hcompleted⟩ :=
    _root_.RHTower.exists_completedLFunction_ne_zero_ray (χ := χ.character)
  refine ⟨(σ : ℂ), ?_⟩
  rw [_root_.RHTower.dirichletXi]
  exact mul_ne_zero
    (Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.mpr (Or.inl (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne N))))
    hcompleted

/-- The analytic Real-zero family extracted from all actual nontrivial primitive self-dual
Dirichlet L-functions of fixed modulus. -/
def selfDualPrimitiveDirichletAnalyticFamily
    (radius : ℝ) (hradius : 0 ≤ radius) :
    CompletedSelfDualAnalyticFamily (SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum N) where
  completed := fun χ => _root_.RHTower.dirichletXi χ.character
  center := 1 / 2
  radius := radius
  radius_nonneg := hradius
  analytic := fun χ => χ.dirichletXi_differentiable.differentiableOn.analyticOnNhd isOpen_univ
  nontrivial := SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum.exists_dirichletXi_ne_zero
  rootNumber := fun χ => χ.character.rootNumber
  rootNumber_ne_zero := fun χ => _root_.RHTower.rootNumber_ne_zero χ.primitive
  functionalEquation := by
    intro χ z
    have h := _root_.RHTower.dirichletXi_one_sub χ.primitive z
    rw [χ.selfDual] at h
    convert h using 1
    all_goals norm_num

theorem selfDualPrimitiveDirichlet_defectRank_eq_analyticRank_add_twice_upper
    (radius : ℝ) (hradius : 0 ≤ radius)
    (χ : SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum N) :
    SelfDualRealZeroFamily.defectRank
        (selfDualPrimitiveDirichletAnalyticFamily radius hradius).toSelfDualRealZeroFamily χ =
      (analyticOrderAt (_root_.RHTower.dirichletXi χ.character) (1 / 2 : ℂ)).toNat +
        2 * SelfDualRealZeroFamily.upperOffCentralMultiplicity
          (selfDualPrimitiveDirichletAnalyticFamily radius hradius).toSelfDualRealZeroFamily χ := by
  simpa [selfDualPrimitiveDirichletAnalyticFamily] using
    CompletedSelfDualAnalyticFamily.defectRank_eq_orderAt_center_add_twice_upper
      (selfDualPrimitiveDirichletAnalyticFamily radius hradius) χ

theorem selfDualPrimitiveDirichlet_analyticRank_parity_rootNumber
    (radius : ℝ) (hradius : 0 ≤ radius)
    (χ : SelfDualPrimitiveDirichletDatum N) :
    (-1 : ℂ) ^
        SelfDualRealZeroFamily.analyticRank
          (selfDualPrimitiveDirichletAnalyticFamily radius hradius).toSelfDualRealZeroFamily χ =
      χ.character.rootNumber := by
  exact CompletedSelfDualAnalyticFamily.analyticRank_parity_sign
    (selfDualPrimitiveDirichletAnalyticFamily radius hradius) χ

end GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

/-!
# Primitive conductor finite Euler factor

This file promotes the finite coefficientwise Möbius correction for an
imprimitive Dirichlet character to an identity of Dirichlet `L`-series in the
certified absolute-convergence half-plane.

The result is deliberately restricted to `Re(s) > 1`. Extending it by
analytic continuation and proving that the finite factor does not add zeros
in a zero-density region are separate closed tasks.
-/

open Complex LSeries DirichletCharacter

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower

/-- The finite primitive Euler correction has a summable `L`-series at every
complex point because its support is contained in the finite divisor set of
the original modulus. -/
theorem lseriesSummable_cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) (s : ℂ) :
    LSeriesSummable (cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection n χ) s := by
  unfold LSeriesSummable
  apply summable_of_hasFiniteSupport
  rw [Function.HasFiniteSupport]
  apply Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet (n + 1).divisors)
  intro d hd
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hd
  by_contra hmem
  have hnot : d ∉ (n + 1).divisors := by
    intro hdmem
    exact hmem hdmem
  rw [LSeries.term] at hd
  by_cases hd0 : d = 0
  · simp [hd0] at hd
  · simp [hd0, cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection, hnot] at hd

/-- The primitive conductor `L`-function attached to a certified nonprincipal
input character. Positivity of the canonical conductor supplies the required
nonzero-modulus instance internally. -/
noncomputable def cglPrimitiveLFunction
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) (s : ℂ) : ℂ := by
  letI : NeZero (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).conductor :=
    ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).conductor_pos⟩
  exact DirichletCharacter.LFunction (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).primitiveCharacter s

/-- In the certified absolute-convergence half-plane, the original character
`L`-function is the product of its finite primitive correction and canonical
primitive conductor `L`-function. -/
theorem cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection_lseries_mul_primitiveLFunction_eq_input
    (n : ℕ) (χ : NonprincipalDirichletCharacter n) (s : CGLAbsoluteConvergencePoint) :
    LSeries (cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection n χ) s.1 *
      cglPrimitiveLFunction n χ s.1 =
      DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ.1 s.1 := by
  unfold cglPrimitiveLFunction
  letI : NeZero (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).conductor :=
    ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).conductor_pos⟩
  calc
    LSeries (cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection n χ) s.1 *
        DirichletCharacter.LFunction (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).primitiveCharacter s.1 =
        LSeries (cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection n χ) s.1 *
          LSeries (fun k => (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).primitiveCharacter k) s.1 := by
      rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_LSeries _ s.2]
    _ = LSeries (LSeries.convolution (cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection n χ)
        (fun k => (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).primitiveCharacter k)) s.1 := by
      exact (LSeries_convolution'
        (lseriesSummable_cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection n χ s.1)
        (DirichletCharacter.LSeriesSummable_of_one_lt_re
          (cglPrimitiveCharacterReduction n χ).primitiveCharacter s.2)).symm
    _ = LSeries (fun k => χ.1 k) s.1 := by
      congr 1
      funext k
      exact cglPrimitiveEulerCorrection_convolution_eq_input n χ k
    _ = DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ.1 s.1 := by
      rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_LSeries _ s.2]

end RHTower

/-- CGL's finite Euler correction `P(s-it)` on the shifted contour. -/
def cglLemma62EulerCorrection (B : CGLLemma62InducedCharacter) (t v : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  cglLemma62EulerLeftFactor B t v / cglLemma62EulerRightFactor B t v

/-- The correction times its nonzero reflected denominator recovers the left
Euler product exactly. -/
theorem cglLemma62EulerCorrection_mul_rightFactor
    (B : CGLLemma62InducedCharacter) (t v : ℝ) :
    cglLemma62EulerCorrection B t v * cglLemma62EulerRightFactor B t v =
      cglLemma62EulerLeftFactor B t v := by
  unfold cglLemma62EulerCorrection
  field_simp [cglLemma62EulerRightFactor_ne_zero B t v]

/-- Inverting the certified inducing identity commutes with changing level. -/
theorem cglLemma62InducedCharacter_inverse_induced_eq
    (B : CGLLemma62InducedCharacter) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel B.conductor_dvd_ambient B.primitive.character⁻¹ =
      B.character⁻¹ := by
  calc
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel B.conductor_dvd_ambient B.primitive.character⁻¹ =
        (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel B.conductor_dvd_ambient B.primitive.character)⁻¹ :=
      map_inv _ _
    _ = B.character⁻¹ := congrArg Inv.inv B.induced_eq

/-- The inverse primitive character is nonprincipal. -/
theorem cglLemma62PrimitiveCharacter_inverse_nonprincipal
    (B : CGLLemma62InducedCharacter) : B.primitive.character⁻¹ ≠ 1 := by
  intro hinv
  apply B.primitive.nonprincipal
  calc
    B.primitive.character = (B.primitive.character⁻¹)⁻¹ := (inv_inv _).symm
    _ = (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ B.primitive.modulus.value)⁻¹ := congrArg Inv.inv hinv
    _ = 1 := inv_one

/-- Exact left-line change-level factorization in CGL (6.3). -/
theorem cglLemma62InducedCharacter_lfunction_leftFactor
    (B : CGLLemma62InducedCharacter) (t v : ℝ) :
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction B.character (cglLemma62LeftPoint t v) =
      DirichletCharacter.LFunction B.primitive.character (cglLemma62LeftPoint t v) *
        cglLemma62EulerLeftFactor B t v := by
  rw [← B.induced_eq]
  simpa only [cglLemma62EulerLeftFactor] using
    (DirichletCharacter.LFunction_changeLevel B.conductor_dvd_ambient B.primitive.character
      (Or.inl B.primitive.nonprincipal))

/-- Exact reflected-right-line change-level factorization for the inverse
character. -/
theorem cglLemma62InducedCharacter_inverse_lfunction_rightFactor
    (B : CGLLemma62InducedCharacter) (t v : ℝ) :
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction B.character⁻¹ (cglLemma62RightPoint t v) =
      DirichletCharacter.LFunction B.primitive.character⁻¹ (cglLemma62RightPoint t v) *
        cglLemma62EulerRightFactor B t v := by
  rw [← cglLemma62InducedCharacter_inverse_induced_eq]
  simpa only [cglLemma62EulerRightFactor] using
    (DirichletCharacter.LFunction_changeLevel B.conductor_dvd_ambient B.primitive.character⁻¹
      (Or.inl (cglLemma62PrimitiveCharacter_inverse_nonprincipal B)))

/-- **CGL (6.3), reflected Euler-factor identity.**  The finite Euler
correction transfers the reflected primitive `L`-function to the original
inverse character without a denominator hypothesis. -/
theorem cglLemma62EulerCorrection_reflected_lfunction
    (B : CGLLemma62InducedCharacter) (t v : ℝ) :
    cglLemma62EulerCorrection B t v *
        DirichletCharacter.LFunction B.character⁻¹ (cglLemma62RightPoint t v) =
      cglLemma62EulerLeftFactor B t v *
        DirichletCharacter.LFunction B.primitive.character⁻¹
          (cglLemma62RightPoint t v) := by
  rw [cglLemma62InducedCharacter_inverse_lfunction_rightFactor]
  rw [show cglLemma62EulerCorrection B t v *
      (DirichletCharacter.LFunction B.primitive.character⁻¹ (cglLemma62RightPoint t v) *
        cglLemma62EulerRightFactor B t v) =
      (cglLemma62EulerCorrection B t v * cglLemma62EulerRightFactor B t v) *
        DirichletCharacter.LFunction B.primitive.character⁻¹ (cglLemma62RightPoint t v) by
      ring]
  rw [cglLemma62EulerCorrection_mul_rightFactor]

end RHTower
